title: House Committee Releases Trump Tax Returns
description_short: The House Ways and Means Committee released six years of Trump’s tax returns after a long legal fight.
description_medium: On December 30, 2022, the House Ways and Means Committee released six years of Donald Trump’s personal and business tax returns after years of legal disputes. The thousands of pages included records from before and during his presidency; the returns showed foreign income and business activity, including reported income from China in 2017.
description_long: On December 30, 2022, the House Ways and Means Committee made public six years of Donald Trump’s personal and business tax returns, ending a long legal fight over access to the records. The release came after the committee voted along party lines to disclose them and staff redacted sensitive personal information. The documents included Trump and Melania Trump’s returns and records from business entities. NBC reported that the 2020 returns showed $78 million in gross income from 16 foreign countries, and that the 2017 returns reported $6.5 million from China; the source did not identify the source of the China income. The returns also showed millions in foreign income and business expenses across at least 22 countries over the period. Trump defended the release as proof of business success and criticized the committee, while its senior Republican called the disclosure unprecedented and harmful to privacy. The records provided material for public scrutiny, but the reported figures alone do not establish wrongdoing.
notes: The linked NBC report provided the release date, scope, committee vote and redaction process, reported foreign-income figures, and competing public responses. Figures are attributed to the returns and report.
